redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/agents.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: agents/archmap-explorer.md exists; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: .venv - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own .venv and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Wrote tests/agents.test.mjs first (cases a1-a3) and saw it fail (agents/archmap-explorer.md did not exist). Then wrote agents/archmap-explorer.md (sonnet, medium, Read/Grep/Glob/Bash; Bash limited to read-only introspection CLIs, never executes scanned code), agents/archmap-synthesizer.md and agents/archmap-reviewer.md (opus, high, Read/Grep/Glob). Each has Input, References, Output sections naming the references it reads. Results: node --test tests/agents.test.mjs 3/3 pass; node --test full suite 132 pass 0 fail; claude plugin validate . passes (only the existing ICON_MISSING directory warning). Design question 13: validate did NOT reject the effort field. However I checked in a scratch copy that validate also passes with a bogus model, bogus effort and broken YAML in an agent's frontmatter, so it does not inspect agent frontmatter at all; acceptance of effort by the runtime is therefore not proven by validate. effort is kept in all three agents. DISCREPANCY for the orchestrator: skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md (not in my files) says the synthesizer 'edits only architecture.model.json', but the design gives it only Read, Grep, Glob, so it cannot write. I made the synthesizer return one JSON object (edges, sequences, access, relations, views, notes, conflicts) that the caller merges and validates; the reviewer likewise returns the issues JSON (SKILL.md already says the caller writes issues.json). SKILL.md step 5 wording should be aligned. Dependants: the three agent files are referenced by docs/design.md by basename; still correct, since names, models, efforts and tools match design section 4 exactly. tests/agents.test.mjs has no tracked dependants.
outcome.descriptive: Adds the three archmap agents with designed model, effort and tool frontmatter, locked by a test; plugin validate passes.
